caption:
#ad Rainy walks are wonderful until four wet feet head straight for the sofa. Just add a little water, slip a paw into the cup, and give it a gentle twist against the soft bristles. The dirt rinses away right at the door before it ever touches your floors.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/

#dogsupplies #mudpaws #dogwalks #petgear
brief: Dog paw cleaner cup: a cup with soft silicone bristles inside. Dip the dog's muddy paw in water, twist gently, and paws come out clean before they reach the floor or sofa. Good for dogs that walk in rain or mud.
